|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 4) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Stalker (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V1-D-stalker-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-stalker022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/stalker.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual1-Dark/large/stalker.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•''Stalker''”. Text: “May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles and 4 TIEs. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. If opponent's starship just moved from here, Stalker may follow it as a regular move (if within range).”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Stalker (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 28 March 2021<ref name="img-stalker35aa2a6">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/stalker.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/35aa2a66de8c2b5feeb1ad348a3a240cdc9ffbef commit 35aa2a6] (28 March 2021); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual1-Dark/large/stalker.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' “passengers, 2 vehicles and 4” → “passengers, 2 vehicles, and 4”; “of 1. If opponent's starship” → “of 1. Once per game, may follow an opponent's starship”; “opponent's starship just moved” → “opponent's starship that just moved”; “moved from here, Stalker may follow it as a regular move (if within” → “moved from here (if within”; the errata mark “E” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none); the bottom margin “•''Stalker''” → “''Stalker''” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (348×488 → 745×1039 pixels). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “''Stalker''”. Text: “May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles, and 4 TIEs. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. Once per game, may follow an opponent's starship that just moved from here (if within range).”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Stalker (V) (Errata 2)]]): PC card image uploaded 5 July 2022<ref name="img-stalkera41bae9">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/stalker.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a41bae9a74e1300c2325f6f584bab72b56ff28fe commit a41bae9] (5 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual1-Dark/large/stalker.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the PC re-made the image at lower resolution (745×1039 → 703×980 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “''Stalker''”. Text: “May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles, and 4 TIEs. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. Once per game, may follow an opponent's starship that just moved from here (if within range).”
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Stalker (V) (Errata 3)]]): PC card image uploaded 3 October 2022<ref name="img-stalkerca1ccff">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/stalker.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ca1ccff62ff30b7e29da803f91a6d09ab542d803 commit ca1ccff] (3 October 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual1-Dark/large/stalker.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
